test_title: PYST 40: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 937, 228, 782, 175, 631 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

NOTE - All operations to be done from left to right.

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the second digit of the lowest number?
solution:
**Given: **937, 228, 782, 175, 631

Highest number = 937

Third digit of the highest number is 7.

Lowest number = 175

Second digit of the lowest number is 7.

Sum = 7 + 7 = 14

Thus, 14 will be the resultant if the third digit of the highest number is added to the second digit of the lowest number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
